source: TSUGU Core vNext plan v2.3 chapter 9

scenarios.title: Bootstrap and idempotent reseed
scenarios.expected: Empty-state bootstrap and repeated seed/migration operations do not create duplicate authoritative records.

scenarios.title: Project architecture Box binding and effective rules
scenarios.expected: Repository/Node/Path/Published Box bindings preserve stable references, type constraints and effective rule derivation.

scenarios.title: Task A output Event blocks and releases Task B
scenarios.expected: Task A can start without its future completion Check while Task B remains BLOCKED until the required current Event exists.

scenarios.title: Authorization and approval rejection/acceptance
scenarios.expected: Insufficient role, cross-Project access, actor spoofing, expired approval and changed-target approval are rejected; only valid approval advances the operation.

scenarios.title: Git diff Evidence PASS and Event establishment
scenarios.expected: Fixed base/head Git facts, FINALIZED EvidenceVersion and matching PASS establish the current Event and make the dependent Task READY.

scenarios.title: FAIL Issue repair Task and resolution lineage
scenarios.expected: The original FAIL remains historical while Issue, repair Task, new Check and explicit resolution lineage remain traceable.

scenarios.title: Invalidation and delayed PASS rejection
scenarios.expected: Commit/Rule/Box/TestDefinition/Deployment/Waiver changes conservatively invalidate dependencies; old-generation delayed PASS cannot restore readiness.

scenarios.title: Multiple Hold reasons Interrupt Resume Cancel and reload
scenarios.expected: Manual and dependency Hold reasons coexist; resolving only one cannot Resume, and runtime history survives serialize/hydrate reload.

scenarios.title: Concurrent Apply retry evidence recovery and sync interruption
scenarios.expected: Concurrent/double Apply, evidence retry, interrupted or reversed sync never leave partial authoritative state or false READY.

scenarios.title: Final approval DONE and later invalidation
scenarios.expected: Required Check/Evidence/reconciliation/final Approval permit DONE; later invalidation preserves DONE history while current assurance and repair Issue/Task reflect the new state.
